# 1.21.x Update

This update brings full compatibility with Minecraft 1.21.x.

### What's New
- Updated to Minecraft 1.21.1 (compatible with 1.21 and above)
- Updated to Fabric API 0.110.0+1.21.1
- Now requires Java 21

### Technical Changes
- Completely rewrote the networking system to use Fabric's new typed `CustomPayload` packet API
- Migrated item settings from `FabricItemSettings` to vanilla `Item.Settings`
- Updated food component API to 1.21 format
- Fixed screen rendering to be compatible with 1.21 UI changes
- Fixed `Identifier` usage to use `Identifier.of()` factory method

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed quiz screen not displaying when using a Study Card
- Fixed config screen text rendering behind background blur
- Fixed statistics view getting stuck on "Loading statistics..."
- Fixed scroll behavior in statistics view

> as requested by MattiaAbate [GitHub Issue #1](https://github.com/thelouisgan/studycraft/issues/1#issue-3655914407)

releases.notes:
## 🎮 Core Gameplay Features

**Automatic Hunger System:** Hunger depletes automatically every 2 seconds by default

**Quiz Card Items:** Right-clickable items that open quiz questions

**Reward/Penalty System:** Gain hunger for correct answers, take damage for wrong answers

## 🎯 Quiz System

**Answer Shuffling: **Answers are randomized for each question

**Immediate Feedback:** Visual indicators for correct/incorrect answers

**Sound Effects:** Audio feedback for correct answers

## 📚 Question Management

**Built-in Question Bank:** Pre-loaded with chemistry questions (flame tests, precipitation reactions)

**Custom Question Format:** Tab-separated question/answer pairs

**Live Question Bank Updates:** Modify questions in real-time without server restart

## ⚙️ Configuration System

**In-Game Config Screen:** Accessible through mod menu (press Y)

**Difficulty Adjustment:** Configurable hunger depletion rate and reward amounts

**Real-Time Updates:** Changes apply immediately to all connected players

## 📊 Statistics & Analytics

**Individual Question Tracking:** Track correct/incorrect answers for each question

**Overall Performance Metrics:** Calculate and display overall accuracy percentage

**Persistent Data Storage:** Statistics saved to JSON files in world data

**Real-Time Stats Requests:** View updated statistics instantly
